# The Open Framework

> An in-development open platform concept for India's social sector, connecting NGOs, donors, and volunteers. This is an early build: the figures, updates and dashboards shown on the site are demo data, not live metrics.

Built by Ayush Rai (backend). Source: https://github.com/ayushrai-hub/the-open-framework
